title: Auriga Martin (board director, growth multiplier) on the Vidya Dinamani × Eric Ries SDSU interview
summary: Auriga Martin — CMInstD board director and growth innovation multiplier — frames the SDSU keynote interview as the reality check the tech sector needs: lock in the mission and form the company's principles legally from day one.
blockquote: Eric's new book Incorruptible is just what the tech sector needs right now. Vidya and Eric covered a wide array of themes but the reality check was really about locking in the mission and forming principles of the company legally from day one.
attribution_title: CMInstD Board Director; growth and ecosystem catalyzer
